senses.gloss: , read פַּרְאִדְרוֹן m. (πάρεδρος, S., accus. form, or παρεδρεύων) familiar, regular visitor.
units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 33:7">Ex. R. s. 33</cite> … <he>כל זמן … הוא הווה פ׳ לבית חמיו משנשאה אצלה</he> so long as he has not married his betrothed, he is a visitor at the house of his father-in-law; after he has married her, her father comes to her.
